model_routing.notes: Operational spawns resolve the LATEST Claude per tier via bin/heimdall-model-resolve (bare alias opus|sonnet|haiku -> Claude Code picks current-gen); pin only for bench/eval reproducibility via HEIMDALL_MODEL_<TIER>=<full-id>. default_code is a TIER (sonnet), not a pinned id. 2026-08-11 user directive: main CC agent stays on the user's default (NOT hardcoded opus); default coding tier is sonnet; fable5 is escalation-only for bad-output loops. opus retained ONLY for reviewer/verifier/security-auditor (adjudication + security judgment). Fable 5 NOT ZDR (30d) - client repos need repo-policy allow_non_zdr_models. Re-spike on Fable 5 before any public delta claim.
model_routing.main_agent: unpinned — agents/heimdall.md declares `tier: inherit`, a first-class declaration meaning it runs the operator's own Claude Code default. hmd never overrides the model the human chose.
model_routing.escalation: effort_ladder first; then sonnet -> opus on first failed verification; fable5 ONLY when a task is looping on bad output (repeated failed attempts at the same step), never as a default
model_routing.effort_ladder: low|medium: lint, docs edits, lookups, research reads, single-file fix with a clear test; default: design, multi-file, security, adjudication; a failed or subpar run reruns one step up before the tier escalates
model_routing.context_window: 1M context is the default wherever the tier supports it. bin/heimdall-model-resolve emits sonnet[1m] (1M is opt-in on sonnet, and the suffix still floats to current-gen); opus and fable are left bare because 1M is already their default maximum; haiku has NO 1m variant (200K) and is exempt. Rationale: a compaction is a lossy rewrite of the context the agent is reasoning over, and compacting repeatedly through one task is how an agent forgets its own acceptance criteria. HEIMDALL_NO_1M=1 opts out for cost-capped or pre-1M bench runs. Above 200K input a long-context premium applies over the base rates in bin/lib/tier-table.json, so a base-rate total for a long session is a floor.
